info.title: Vex Protocol API
info.description: REST API for the Vex encrypted chat platform. Messages are serialized using msgpack.

owner.description: Server ID that owns this emoji

intent.description: Explicit account creation or device enrollment intent

password.description: Account password. Required for new accounts and for existing-account device approval requests unless the request is authorized by passkey.

post.summary: Sign in with username and password
post.description: Verify username and password credentials and return a bounded user bearer. Passkeys are optional and use the separate passkey authentication flow.
Initiate device-key authentication by submitting a deviceID and signing key. Returns a challenge nonce to sign.

Submit a challenge signed by a previously approved device key and return a bounded user bearer. This powers trusted-device session restoration and does not bypass initial account or device enrollment.
Create a new user account with password authentication and cryptographic device registration. The account may enroll passkeys later.

intent.description: Explicit account creation or device enrollment intent

password.description: Account password. Required for new accounts and for existing-account device approval requests unless the request is authorized by passkey.

post.description: Return the current authenticated session including token expiry and user profile.
Provide a clean authenticated session boundary. Access tokens are stateless and remain expiry-based; clients must discard their local bearer.

get.description: Request a scoped, time-limited action token for operations like registration, file upload, or device pairing.
Retrieve the public profile for a user by their ID.
List all registered devices for the given user, including signing keys and login timestamps.

patch.description: Replace a password after current-password proof from an approved device, or after a fresh user-verified passkey ceremony. The authenticated account must match the path user.

401.description: Required current-password or passkey proof failed

403.description: Authenticated account does not match the path

get.description: List all chat servers the given user is a member of.
List all permission grants for the given user across all resources.

post.description: Create a short-lived challenge that the authenticated device must sign before this homeserver prepares portable account data.

403.description: Account or device is not active locally

post.description: Verify the device-signed challenge and retain a time-limited source transfer. Portable state is frozen only after the finalized registry route moves to the destination.

403.description: Authorization or device signature is invalid

409.description: Authorization nonce conflicts with prior use

post.description: Import authoritative room references, encrypted attachments, queued ciphertext, and the public avatar from the previous homeserver after the registry route is finalized.

403.description: Account or device is not active locally

409.description: Finalized route or migration state is invalid

get.description: Retrieve details for a chat server by its ID.

post.description: Create a new chat server. The path parameter is used as the server name.

delete.description: Permanently delete a chat server. Requires owner-level permissions.

get.description: List all channels belonging to the given server.

post.description: Create a new channel within the given server.

get.description: Retrieve details for a channel by its ID.

delete.description: Permanently delete a channel. Requires sufficient permissions on the parent server.

get.description: Retrieve details for a server invite, including expiration and target server.

patch.description: Accept a server invite, granting the authenticated user membership and returning the new permission grant.

get.description: Returns server and database readiness status. Used by load balancers and monitoring.
